item.title: Categories
item.description: Grading Categories # The required course components total 100%. There is no final exam or optional project bonus. Component Course weight Quizzes 1–14 15% Midterm exam 10% Individual project 35% Team project 40% Total 100% Quiz 0 is required preparation but carries no course-grade weight. See Quizzes and Exams for assessment rules and Project Breakdown for the two project tracks. Project rubrics describe how each stage is evaluated; this table does not assign separate course-grade percentages to project stages.
